description: OpenTofu .tofu file: S3 bucket with no server-side encryption configuration
note: The same case as s3-no-encryption, in a .tofu file rather than .tf, to pin that OpenTofu is covered by the rules already written. Trivy parses .tofu as terraform. Measured 2026-09-16: checkov raised nothing at all on the .tofu file, where the identical .tf case (s3-no-encryption) raises CKV_AWS_145 plus six others. So checkov's terraform runner does not open .tofu, and OpenTofu is Trivy-only coverage -- and it means a single-source self-check for these files. This was described as the mirror of Bicep being checkov-only until 2026-09-23, when KICS gave Bicep a second source; OpenTofu is now the only single-source target left.
